model_name: Dual-Polarimetric Sentinel-1 U-Net (Corrected Input dB Normalization)
strengths: Corrected SAR dB preprocessing restored physical spatial gradient flow and feature learning.
Meaningful spatial learning with true positive pixel discovery increasing from 1,018 (V2) to 73,886 (V4-512) and 69,281 (V4-256).
Strong clean-ocean selectivity with Clean-Ocean FPR at 0.2812% (Mode A) and 0.2073% (Mode B).
Clear separation in output probability distribution between true oil (median 0.978) and clean ocean water (median 0.020).
limitations: Severe look-alike false positives with Look-Alike FPR at 59.55% (Mode A) and 59.77% (Mode B).
Low positive predictive value / precision (1.63% in Mode A, 1.75% in Mode B).
High overall FPR (21.53% in Mode A, 18.69% in Mode B) on unconstrained scenes containing low-wind damping zones.
Physical inability of single-sensor SAR backscatter to distinguish biogenic surfactants and calm water from mineral oil slicks without multimodal MetOcean wind data.
operational_guidance: Do NOT use Model V4 as a standalone automated production alert system. Classify as experimental candidate requiring multimodal MetOcean and AIS drift fusion.
